title: m3a root-motion rate sweep baseline (library/baselines/rates.json)
description: The rows of the root-motion rate sweep that fail (D123, tools/sweep/rates.ts): each locomotion loop with contacts played at each rate on each body, moved by its root's travel, and each loop that fails a row answered: its cause and why (D127). npm run sweep -- --rates --check fails on a failing row not here or a failing loop with no answer; --baseline rewrites it from a whole run, carrying the answers of the loops that still fail. That each answer's cause is one of causes is the validator's (rateBaselineProblems).
